final_text: Wicks should be trimmed to a height of 4 millimetres. [fixture_lighthouse_manual §1.1] Trimming a wick too short results in a dim beam. [fixture_lighthouse_manual §1.1] Leaving a wick too long causes soot on the lens. [fixture_lighthouse_manual §1.1]

The eligibility requirements:
Applicants must be at least 18 years old. [fixture_permit_handbook §1] The sources differ: “Applicants must provide proof of residence” [fixture_permit_handbook §1] / “Proof of residence is optional for all applicants” [fixture_permit_notice_2025 §1]. Applicants who hold a suspended permit cannot apply. [fixture_permit_handbook §1]

The application process for the permit:
Applications are submitted online through the permit portal. [fixture_permit_handbook §2] Each application is reviewed by a permit officer. [fixture_permit_handbook §2] Applicants receive the decision by post. [fixture_permit_handbook §2]

Ladders are permitted in the orchard only when a second worker holds the base of the ladder. [Doc_07 §2.1] Ladders are not permitted in the orch: overnight. [Doc_07 §2.2] Ladders must be returned to the tool shed. [Doc_07 §2.2]

Ladders are not permitted in the orch: overnight. [Doc_07 §2.2] Ladders must be returned to the tool shed. [Doc_07 §2.2] Ladders are permitted in the orchard only when a second worker holds the base of the ladder. [Doc_07 §2.1]

A picker may fill at most 40 crates per shift. [Doc_07 §3] Damaged fruit is placed in the compost bin, not in the crates. [Doc_07 §3] The harvest supervisor checks the crate count at the end of every shift. [Doc_07 §3] Crates are stacked no more than five high. [Doc_07 §3]

Permits must be renewed every 2 years. [fixture_permit_handbook §3] A renewal can be requested up to 30 days before the permit expires. [fixture_permit_handbook §3] Not established: The retrieved documents do not state the value asked for in “How much does it cost to renew a permit”.
The sources differ: “The application fee for a new permit is 40 euros” [fixture_permit_notice_2023 §1] / “The application fee for a new permit is 55 euros” [fixture_permit_notice_2025 §1].
Each application is reviewed by a permit officer. [fixture_permit_handbook §2]

A picker may fill at most 40 crates per shift. [Doc_07 §3] Damaged fruit is placed in the compost bin, not in the crates. [Doc_07 §3] The harvest supervisor checks the crate count at the end of every shift. [Doc_07 §3] Crates are stacked no more than five high. [Doc_07 §3]
The permit office is closed on public holidays. [fixture_permit_bulletin §1]
